en: Mount Mayon in Albay is a highly active stratovolcano famous for its near-perfect conical shape.
Super Typhoon Yolanda, known internationally as Haiyan, produced devastating storm surges in Tacloban City in 2013.
The rich volcanic soil surrounding Mount Kanlaon in Negros Occidental is ideal for growing sugarcane.
The province of Romblon is globally recognized for mining and crafting high-quality white marble.
The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River in Palawan flows directly into the sea, completing a unique water cycle.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a massive, persistent anticyclonic storm that is wider than planet Earth.
Sirius, located in the Canis Major constellation, is the brightest star visible in the night sky.
Apollo 11 astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed their module in the Moon's Sea of Tranquility.
The Philippines experiences a Corona Type 1 climate, featuring distinct wet and dry seasons from November to April.
The magnitude 7.8 Luzon earthquake of July 1990 caused massive structural destruction in Baguio City.
The Mohs hardness scale uses talc as its softest mineral, rating it at a one.
The asteroid Vesta is the second-most massive object in the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.
